candidates.label: Rome (historic center)
candidates.support: Rome's location as capital of the Roman Empire is undisputed; Pleiades and Wikidata's coordinates for the historic city center agree closely.

summary.text: Rome was the capital of the Roman Empire. Acts ends with Paul under house arrest there awaiting trial, and Paul's letter to the Romans is addressed to the believers already established in the city before his arrival.
